verses.text: After Israel was taken captive and Jerusalem laid waste, Jeremiah sat weeping and lamented this lament over Jerusalem, saying: How the city once full of peoples sat alone! She has become like a widow, she who was populous among the nations. A ruler among the regions has become subject to tribute.
